acquire_command.description: Command that starts one acquisition of a detector.

beam_intensity_readback.description: Scalar beam intensity or charge readback (e.g. BPM .VAL).

beam_lifetime_readback.description: Measured lifetime readback of the stored beam.

blade_position_readback.description: Measured insertion of a scraper blade into the beam aperture.

blade_position_setpoint.description: Commanded insertion of a scraper blade into the beam aperture.

bpm_sum_readback.description: BPM sum-signal readback (intensity proxy from button electrodes).

coolant_flow_readback.description: Measured cooling-water flow through a device.

counts_readback.description: Total counts a detector recorded in its last acquisition.

current_golden_readback.description: Stored "golden" current setpoint reference for a powered device.

current_readback.description: Measured current value read back from a powered device.

current_setpoint.description: Commanded current value sent to a powered device.

gap_readback.description: Measured magnetic gap of an insertion device.

gap_setpoint.description: Commanded magnetic gap of an insertion device.

gun_voltage_readback.description: High-voltage readback from an electron gun HVPS (measured kV).

gun_voltage_setpoint.description: High-voltage setpoint for an electron gun or its HVPS (preset demand, kV).

move_command.description: Command that starts a move to the position setpoint.

move_status.description: Whether a move runs, has ended or failed.

offset_readback.description: Measured longitudinal offset (phase) of an insertion device's magnet rows.

offset_setpoint.description: Commanded longitudinal offset (phase) of an insertion device's magnet rows.

operation_mode_status.description: Current operating mode of the machine (e.g. user operation, machine development, shutdown).

phase_readback.description: Measured RF phase readback for an RF cavity.

phase_setpoint.description: Commanded RF phase setpoint for an RF cavity.

position_offset.description: Stored offset subtracted from a measured position.

position_x_readback.description: Horizontal beam position readback from a beam position monitor.

position_y_readback.description: Vertical beam position readback from a beam position monitor.

power_on_command.description: Commanded power on/off transition for a powered device.

power_on_status.description: Power-on (energised) state readback of a powered device.

pulse_waveform.description: Sampled time trace of one output pulse of a pulsed device (e.g. a septum or kicker current pulse), read as an array of samples rather than a scalar.

ramp_gain_readback.description: Readback of the gain applied to a ramped power supply's ramp table.

ramp_gain_setpoint.description: Commanded gain that scales the whole energy-ramp table of a ramped power supply.

ramp_offset_readback.description: Readback of the offset applied to a ramped power supply's ramp table.

ramp_offset_setpoint.description: Commanded offset added to the whole energy-ramp table of a ramped power supply.

ready_status.description: Device-ready handshake readback (interlocks satisfied, supplies up).

rf_forward_power_readback.description: RF forward power readback at an accelerating cavity input.

rf_reflected_power_readback.description: RF reflected power readback from an accelerating cavity.

spectrum_readback.description: Counts per energy channel a detector recorded in its last acquisition.

stop_command.description: Command that ends a running move.

temperature_limit_readback.description: Temperature above which a device's over-temperature interlock trips.

temperature_setpoint.description: Commanded temperature of a regulated loop (e.g. a cooling-water heater).

vacuum_readback.description: Vacuum pressure readback from a vacuum gauge or pump.

valve_position_readback.description: Measured opening of a modulating valve, in percent.

valve_status.description: Open/closed/fault status readback for a beamline gate valve or fast valve.
